name: MonarchAiFollowUpSuggestions
title: AiFollowUpSuggestions
summary: Follow-up questions shown after an assistant reply, as chips that wrap onto new rows; choosing one hands its text to the app.
whenToUse: Under the latest assistant reply, to offer two to four questions the person is likely to ask next.
whenNotToUse: Before the first message use MonarchAiStarterPrompts. For filters or user data use MonarchTag.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiFollowUpSuggestions(suggestions: List<String>, onSelect: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, label: String? = null)

options.name: suggestions
options.description: Questions the person might ask next, as complete prompts, already localised. Trimmed; blank and repeated ones are left out.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the text of the chosen suggestion.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the chips can be chosen, for example false while a reply is generated.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the TalkBack name of the group, "Suggested follow-ups" (monarch_aifollowupsuggestions_label).

states.name: pressed
states.description: The chip takes the hovered-subtle assistant fill; the change is animated only when animations are on. A mouse hover takes the subtle assistant fill.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The text uses the disabled text color and the border the default border color; the chips do not respond.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no suggestion left after trimming, nothing is shown.

appearance: Pill-shaped chips with the surface fill, a one-pixel assistant border and the label type in the strong assistant color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web row is one keyboard tab stop with arrow-key movement (a toolbar); Android has no such pattern, so each chip is its own Material 3 SuggestionChip that TalkBack, Switch Access and a keyboard reach in order. The web chips wrap onto new rows and so do these, in a FlowRow; iOS scrolls one row sideways instead. A chip is at most 288dp wide and shows two lines, as on iOS. Disabling uses the enabled parameter.
accessibility: The group is a traversal group with the content description "Suggested follow-ups", replaceable with label.
Each chip is one element with the button role, read by its full text even when the visible text is cut after two lines.
Each chip has a 48dp touch target reserved in the layout by Material 3.
The chips follow the layout direction: in right to left the first chip is at the right.
Disabled chips are reported as disabled and do not call onSelect.
edgeCases: A long suggestion wraps to two lines inside a chip at most 288dp wide, then is cut with an ellipsis.
Repeated suggestions are shown once; suggestions that differ only by surrounding spaces count as repeats.
With an empty list, or only blank suggestions, the component takes no space.

examples.title: After a reply
Disabled while a reply is generated
examples.code:
MonarchAiFollowUpSuggestions(
    suggestions = listOf("Show it as a table"),
    onSelect = {},
    enabled = false,
)
